item: Fable F-N04 / D790-A04 -- obtain the EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 (and ER-TPC035-6 / FT6236) primary specification
why_it_matters: the +3V3 budget carries a DECLARED 50 mA allowance for the display module's panel-logic and touch side, because ILI Technology's ILI9488 datasheet publishes Sleep-in (100 uA) and Deep Standby (1 uA) and NO active-mode supply current at all.  An exact module figure would replace a declaration with a source.

attempts.result: HTTP 403, with a browser User-Agent, Accept-Language and Referer set
HTTP 200 but text/html, not a PDF

note: this is recorded rather than left implied.  D-791 / a-403-is-not-an-unobtainable-datasheet: a 403 means THIS environment cannot fetch it, not that the document does not exist.  A human with a browser can obtain it, and doing so is a cheap improvement to the +3V3 budget that would replace the declared allowance with a published figure.
what_stands_in_for_it: a DECLARED 50 mA panel-logic + touch allowance, labelled as declared, roughly 2x what a 3.5 in ILI9488 module of this class draws
a reported SENSITIVITY of the derived envelope at 1.5x and 2x that allowance
C-DISP-01 first-article measurement, which is the measurement of record and splits the module's draw into panel logic and backlight-converter input
